# Advisories `scripts/check_advisories.sh` lets through, one per line:
#   <id> <ignore|until-fixed>  # <package> <version>: <why it stays>
# `until-fixed` stops ignoring an advisory once a fixed release exists.
# Remove a line once the lock moves past it: the check fails on any other.
